data.name: Countess's Submission Pact
data.detailed_description:
Countess's Submission Pact - An Immersive Visual Interactive Novel.

Core Plot Introduction
On a rainy night in London, the young butler Freddie James was pushed off the third - floor balcony and was critically injured for exposing the secret that the trust fund was transferred after the earl's death. At a critical moment, a silver - blue stream of light merged into his body, and the mysterious No. 7 consciousness helped him be reborn. After his rebirth, Freddie was no longer the meek butler. He faced the countess Elizabeth directly, exposed the truth that she was threatened by the FX Group and her daughter was used as a bargaining chip, and made pacts with her, the head maid Valeria, and the chief maid Audrey, vowing to cut off the hand pressing on their heads for them.

Worldview Atmosphere
The story is shrouded in a mysterious and tense atmosphere, where surreal elements are intertwined with the real world. Science - fiction settings such as the silver - blue mysterious power and consciousness insects add a touch of fantasy to the story. At the same time, the background of the noble manor and the conspiracy of the underground organization create a depressing and suspense - filled atmosphere.

Highlights of Female Character Interaction
The countess Elizabeth is noble and elegant but also vulnerable and helpless. The head maid Valeria is strong - willed and decisive. The chief maid Audrey is gentle and sensitive. When facing the crisis, the three women have complex and delicate interactions with Freddie. From initial shock and doubt to gradually trusting and submitting to Freddie, they show the struggle and transformation of women in difficult situations.

Tension in Character Relationships
Between Freddie and the countess, there is not only a change in the master - servant relationship but also an entanglement of emotions and interests. There is also a game of trust and doubt between him and the head maid and the chief maid. Among the three women, in the face of a common crisis, there is both mutual support and their own ulterior motives, making the character relationships full of tension.

Scene Features
The story scenes are rich and diverse, from the stormy outside of the manor to the warm classical study, then to the luxurious high - class restaurant, and the dim carriage interior. Each scene is closely connected with the plot, creating different atmospheres.

Immersive Experience
Players will follow Freddie's perspective to immerse themselves in this world full of conspiracies and crises. Through delicate plot descriptions and character interactions, players will feel as if they are in the story, experiencing the joys and sorrows of the characters and the exciting adventures.

High - definition Visual Performance
The game uses high - definition graphics, carefully depicting each scene and character. The delicate lighting effects and realistic details bring visual enjoyment to players. Whether it is the gorgeous costumes of the nobles or the silver - blue mysterious data stream, they will be presented in the most realistic pictures.

Functional Gameplay Features
It supports offline play, allowing players to immerse themselves in the story anytime and anywhere. The one - key backtracking function makes it convenient for players to review important plots. The automatic play function allows players to easily browse the plot. The chapter browsing function can quickly locate the chapters of interest. The high - definition CG display brings a more intuitive visual experience to players, and the smooth reading experience allows players to focus on the story itself.

data.short_description: The butler Freddie was pushed off the third floor. On the verge of death, he was reborn with the help of a mysterious power. He exposed the secret of the earl's inheritance and made pacts with the countess and other women, vowing to cut off the mastermind behind the scenes.
